intro: Passage 3 — imtihondagi eng qiyin va eng uzun matn: ko'pincha jurnal maqolasi, unda muallifning fikri bor. Unit 8 da uchta savol turi birga keladi: Multiple choice (A, B, C yoki D), YES / NO / NOT GIVEN va Matching sentence endings.

XARITA (1–2 daqiqa). Uchala guruhni ko'zdan kechiring. MCQ odatda matn boshidan oxirigacha tartib bilan boradi va savolning o'zi paragrafni aytadi ("in the first paragraph", "in paragraph 2"). Y/N/NG ham tartib bilan. Sentence endings ham tartibda (Exam advice: "You will find them in the same order"), lekin u matnning ma'lum qismiga — masalan, faqat restavratsiya bosqichlariga — tegishli bo'ladi.

MCQ ning to'rt xili bor: 1) faktik savol ("Zenzie says the project is special because..."); 2) paragraf mavzusi ("What is the main topic of the first paragraph?") — butun paragrafni qamrab olgan variant tanlanadi, bitta gapni emas; 3) muallif maqsadi ("to describe / to explain / to compare") — paragraf NIMA QILAYOTGANINI so'raydi; 4) sarlavha ("most suitable title") — ENG OXIRIDA, subheading va har paragrafning birinchi gapi bo'yicha.

MCQ tuzog'i: variantdagi so'z matnda bor, lekin boshqa ma'noda. Exam advice: "Find the option which expresses the same idea; don't just match words." Har variantni isbot gap bilan tekshiring va nega qolgan uchtasi noto'g'ri ekanini ayting.

YES / NO / NOT GIVEN — T/F/NG ning "egizagi", lekin savol FAKT haqida emas, MUALLIF FIKRI (views / claims) haqida. Muallif fikrini baho so'zlari beradi: in my view, I believe, unfortunately, it is a pity, there's no doubt, too harsh, naive, it isn't hard to see. YES — muallif shunday deydi; NO — muallif teskarisini aytadi; NOT GIVEN — muallif bu haqda hech narsa demaydi (masalan, kelajak haqidagi taxmin, taqqoslash, baho).

Sentence endings: savol boshidagi kalit so'zni (Pictures, A special machine, Nicholas Coleridge, The head of Dior) matnda toping, shu gapni o'qing, keyin tugallanmalar ichidan MA'NOSI mosini tanlang. Tugallanmalar 6 ta, savollar 4 ta — ikkitasi tuzoq. Tugallangan gap grammatik jihatdan ham to'g'ri bo'lishi kerak.
Vaqt: Passage 3 ga 20 daqiqa. Taxminan: xarita 2, MCQ 7, Y/N/NG 5, endings 4, tekshiruv 2. Sarlavha savolini oxirga qoldiring — matnni o'qib bo'lganingizdan keyin u 30 soniyada yechiladi.
formulas: Y/N/NG da muallif baho so'zini toping
unlike, there's no doubt, a pity
Endings: savol boshidagi kalit so'zni toping
presentation: T/F/NG va Y/N/NG ning farqi nima?
T/F/NG — matndagi ma'lumot (fakt). Y/N/NG — muallifning fikri yoki da'vosi. Yechish usuli bir xil, lekin Y/N/NG da baho so'zlariga e'tibor bering.
MCQ da "writer's purpose" savoli nimani so'raydi?
Paragraf nima qilayotganini: tushuntiradimi, solishtiradimi, tasvirlaydimi. Paragrafdagi bitta faktni emas, uning vazifasini tanlang.
Sarlavha savolini qachon ishlayman?
Eng oxirida. Subheading'ni qayta o'qing va har paragrafning birinchi gapini ko'zdan kechiring (Exam advice).
Sentence endings da ikkita tugallanma mos kelyapti.
Matndagi gapni qayta o'qing: qaysi biri aynan shu narsa haqida aytilgan? Ikkinchisi odatda boshqa savolga yoki hech qaysi savolga tegishli emas.
Muallif fikrini aytmasa-chi?
Unda javob NOT GIVEN. Masalan, muallif loyiha 700 soat olishini aytadi, lekin bu reja realmi-yo'qmi — baho bermaydi.
Uchta guruhni qaysi tartibda ishlayman?
Odatda tartib bilan. Faqat sarlavha savoli oxiriga qoladi. Endings uchun kalit so'zlar (ismlar) aniq bo'lsa, ularni oldindan belgilab qo'ying.
notes: 5.0 da MCQ, Y/N/NG va sentence endings alohida o'rganilgan. Bugungi yangilik — ular Passage 3 da birga keladi va vaqt 20 daqiqa.
Har Y/N/NG javobidan keyin so'rang: "Bu fakt yoki muallif fikrimi? Qaysi so'z fikrni bildiradi?"
30-Day Reading Challenge'da Day 9 — Student's Book matni, Day 12 — Workbook matni bilan bir xil. Ularni uyga BERMANG; o'quvchi javobni allaqachon biladi.
Kuchli o'quvchilarga: MCQ ning har bir noto'g'ri variantiga "nega noto'g'ri" izohini yozish.
mistakes: Variantdagi so'z matnda bor bo'lgani uchun uni tanlash
Exam advice: don't just match words
Y/N/NG da faktni tekshirib, muallif fikrini unutish
Sentence endings da ma'noni emas, so'zni moslash

how: CORE — kiyim va mato haqidagi asosiy so'zlar; STRONG — restavratsiya va dizayn; SUPER — moda sanoati iboralari.
Har so'z bilan o'quvchi o'z kiyimi yoki milliy liboslar haqida bitta gap tuzsin: "My grandmother's atlas dress is very fragile now."
core: This garment must be washed by hand.
Silk is a light and smooth fabric.
She bought three metres of cloth.
U uch metr mato sotib oldi.
The actors' costumes were made by hand.
She wore a new outfit to the wedding.
The repair was done with tiny stitches.
Ta'mir juda mayda choklar bilan qilingan.
Experts are restoring the old palace.
The old dress is too fragile to wear.
Eski ko'ylak kiyish uchun juda mo'rt.
Young designers show their work in Tashkent every autumn.
Yosh dizaynerlar har kuzda Toshkentda ishlarini ko'rsatadi.
Uzbekistan is famous for its silk textiles.
strong: Conservation of old clothes needs special skills.
Eski kiyimlarni asrash maxsus mahorat talab qiladi.
The robe has an intricate pattern.
Jeans became an iconic piece of clothing.
The stitches are decorative, not functional.

Yuqori moda ko'ylaklari uy narxida bo'lishi mumkin.
Good design stands the test of time.
This coat is good value for money.

class_ex.title: Fakt yoki fikr?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz gapni o'qiydi. O'quvchilar aytadi: bu FAKT (T/F/NG uchun) yoki MUALLIF FIKRI (Y/N/NG uchun)? Fikrni bildiruvchi so'zni ko'rsating.
items: The dress was first worn on stage in 1888.
It is a pity that so few people know how ikat is made.
The project will need more than 700 hours of work.
In my view, the critics of these repair schemes are too harsh.
Unlike many other actresses of her time, she kept her costumes.
There is no doubt that she would be delighted with the result.
why: Sana — tekshirish mumkin bo'lgan ma'lumot.
"A pity" — muallifning munosabati.
Raqam va reja — fakt; muallif bu reja realmi-yo'qmi demayapti.
"In my view" — fikrning eng aniq belgisi.
Muallif Ellen Terry'ni boshqa aktrisalar bilan solishtiryapti — Y/N/NG savollari ko'pincha shunday gaplarga quriladi (SB 10-savol).
"There is no doubt" — muallif o'z ishonchini bildiradi.
class_ex.note: Mashqdan keyin: Y/N/NG savoli faqat "fikr" gaplardan emas, muallif fakt sifatida da'vo qilgan gaplardan ham tuzilishi mumkin. Asosiy qoida — "muallif shunday deydimi?"

class_ex.title: dress / dresses / clothes / cloth (SB Vocabulary)
class_ex.instr: Har gapga dress, dresses, clothes yoki cloth dan birini qo'ying. Keyin qoidani ayting.
items: I need to buy some new ___ for my trip.
She wore a long silk ___ to the concert.
The robe was made from a heavy cotton ___.
Traditional ___ is worn at weddings in many countries.
The shop sells ___ in all sizes, from small to extra large.
Children's ___ should be comfortable and easy to wash.
why: Clothes — har doim ko'plik, umumiy kiyim-kechak.
A dress — sanaladigan: ayollar ko'ylagi.
Cloth — mato, sanalmaydi.
Dress (sanalmaydigan) — kiyinish uslubi: traditional dress, formal dress.
Dresses — bir nechta ko'ylak.
Clothes — "clothings" yoki "a clothes" deyilmaydi.
class_ex.note: SB dagi xato gaplar: "similar dresses" (→ clothes), "cloth to wear" (→ clothes). Imtihonda ham, Writing'da ham ko'p uchraydi.

readings.title: Student's Book: The Beetlewing dress
readings.qtype: Multiple choice (1–6) + Yes / No / Not Given (7–10) + Sentence endings (11–14)
readings.source: Complete IELTS 5–6.5, Student's Book, Unit 8 — sinfda tushuntirish
readings.book_ref: Student's Book, 77–80-betlar (2-mashq, matn, Questions 1–14). Kitob sahifalari quyida rasm sifatida berilgan.
paraphrases: She tried hard to look good on stage
one of the most iconic and celebrated costumes of the age
expose more people to Shakespeare's plays
brought new audiences to see masterpieces
the painting remains almost as fresh as the day it was painted
people know who wore the dress
it's quite unusual to know who actually wore a garment
an astonishingly intricate project / a huge undertaking
Zenzie and the National Trust will decide how far back ... as some members feel
remove the dirt from the top layer

the original cloth is quite stretchy ... a certain amount of flexibility
Work will be visible on one side

tasks.title: Questions 1–6
tasks.type: Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D
tasks.instr: Choose the correct letter, A, B, C or D. Savollar matn tartibida; sarlavha savoli (bo'lsa) — eng oxirida ishlanadi. 1, 3, 5 — faktik savollar; 2 — muallif maqsadi; 4 — taqqoslash; 6 — sarlavha.
items: 1 What do you learn about Ellen Terry in the first paragraph? A) Lady Macbeth was her first leading role. B) The Lyceum was her favourite theatre. C) She tried hard to look good on stage. D) She wanted to look young for her audience.

2 What is the writer's purpose in paragraph 2? A) to describe different responses to the Beetlewing dress B) to explain why the Beetlewing dress had such a big impact C) to consider the suitability of the Beetlewing dress for the play D) to compare the look of the Beetlewing dress on and off the stage

3 According to the writer, the main effect of the Lyceum productions was to A) expose more people to Shakespeare's plays. B) reduce the interest in other types of production. C) raise the cost of going to the theatre. D) encourage writers to produce more plays.

4 In the fourth paragraph, what comparison does the writer make between Sargent's portrait and the Beetlewing dress? A) The dress has attracted more attention than the painting. B) The dress is worth more money than the painting. C) The painting took longer to produce. D) The painting looks newer.

5 Zenzie says the Beetlewing project is particularly special because A) the dress is very old. B) people know who wore the dress. C) the dress was designed by someone famous. D) there is evidence that the dress has been used.
6 Which of the following is the most suitable title for the passage? A) A lesson from the past B) A challenging task C) An unusual fashion show D) An unexpected discovery
why: "She knew the power of presentation and carefully cultivated her image." A — Lady Macbeth "a main character", lekin birinchi roli ekani aytilmagan; D — yosh ko'rinish haqida gap yo'q.

Paragraf libosni tasvirlab, uning ta'sirini tushuntiradi va shunday tugaydi: "became one of the most iconic and celebrated costumes of the age". A — tomoshabinlarning "gasp" i 1-paragrafda va bitta reaksiya; D — "no mere stage trickery" sahnadan tashqaridagi ko'rinish bilan solishtirish emas.

"The innovations sold tickets and brought new audiences to see masterpieces that they would not otherwise have seen." Masterpieces = Shakespeare's plays. B — melodramalar ham qo'yilgan, qiziqish kamaygani aytilmagan.
"While the painting remains almost as fresh as the day it was painted, the years have not been so kind to the dress." Rasm yangi ko'rinadi — libos eskirgan.

"It's quite unusual to know who actually wore a garment. That's the thing that makes the Beetlewing project so special." D — tuzoq: "sweat stains and wear marks" har qanday eski kiyimda bor, maxsus sabab emas.
Subheading: "An astonishingly intricate project"; Zenzie: "extraordinarily difficult", "a huge undertaking". C — moda shousi yo'q; D — libos kutilmaganda topilmagan.
tasks.note: 6-savolni oxirida ishlang va subheading'ni qayta o'qing. 5-savolda D ni tanlagan o'quvchiga Zenzie'ning "But" so'zidan keyingi gapini ko'rsating — asosiy fikr "but" dan keyin keladi.

tasks.title: Questions 7–10
tasks.type: YES / NO / NOT GIVEN
tasks.instr: YES — gap muallifning fikriga mos keladi; NO — muallifning fikriga zid; NOT GIVEN — muallif bu haqda nima deb o'ylashini aytib bo'lmaydi. Savollar matnning ikkinchi yarmiga (restavratsiya loyihasi) tegishli.
items: The National Trust conducted useful research to assist Zenzie's plans for the dress.
There will be some discussion over the changes that Zenzie's team should make to the dress.
Zenzie's estimate for the timing of the project is realistic.
Ellen Terry's attitude towards her dresses was typical of her time.
why: National Trust faqat pul yig'ish loyihasini boshlagan ("a fundraising project was launched"); tekshiruvni Zenzie va uning jamoasi O'TKAZADI (kelajak zamon): "she and her team will conduct a thorough investigation". Kim va qachon — ikkalasi ham zid.

"Zenzie and the National Trust will decide how far back to take the reconstruction, as some members feel that even the most recent changes are now part of the history of the dress." Turli fikr bor — demak muhokama bo'ladi.
Muallif faqat raqamlarni beradi: "more than 700 hours' work". Bu reja realmi-yo'qmi — muallif baho bermaydi.
"Unlike many other actresses, she valued her costumes because she kept and reused them time and time again." "Typical" — "unlike" ning teskarisi.
tasks.note: 7-savol — Y/N/NG ning eng yaxshi misoli: National Trust matnda bor, "investigation" ham bor, lekin ular bir-biriga bog'lanmagan. Kim nima qilganini tekshiring.

tasks.title: Questions 11–14
tasks.type: Complete each sentence with the correct ending, A–F
tasks.instr: Complete each sentence with the correct ending, A–F. Oltita tugallanma bor, faqat to'rttasi kerak — ikkitasi ortiqcha. Tugallangan gapni to'liq o'qib, ma'no va grammatikani tekshiring.
items: 11 Pictures will be used
12 A special machine will be used
13 A net material has been selected
14 Work will be visible on one side
why: Tekshiruv "will involve close examination of the dress for signs of damage and wear, and will be aided by comparing it with John Singer Sargent's painting and contemporary photographs". Rasmlar ta'mir qayerda kerakligini aniqlashga yordam beradi.
"The first stages ... will involve delicate surface cleaning, using a small vacuum suction device." Surface = top layer.
"The original cloth is quite stretchy, so we've deliberately chosen net because that has a certain amount of flexibility in it too." Stretchy = flexibility — asl matoning xususiyati.
"We'll retain all the evidence on the reverse so that future experts will be able to see exactly what we've done." Reverse = one side.
tasks.note: Ortiqcha tugallanmalar: B (vaqtni qisqartirish — matnda aksincha, 700 soat) va D (jamoa sifatini ko'rsatish — "none of our work will be noticeable"). 14-savolda D va A ni solishtiring: maqsad sifatni ko'rsatish emas, NIMA QILINGANINI ko'rsatish.

Scherrer xarajatlarini e'lon qildi "to howls of 'treason' from his colleagues" — hamkasblari g'azablangan. B — boshqalardan yomonroq ahvolda ekani aytilmagan.

"When such a temple of old wealth starts talking about value for money, it isn't to convince anyone that dresses ... are a bargain. Rather, it is to preserve the peculiar mystique..." — ular uchun bu ibora o'zgacha ma'noga ega.

Ikkala tomon haute couture qanday omon qolishi — kelajagi haqida bahslashadi. D — tuzoq: "change" so'zi bor, lekin bahs QANDAY o'zgarishlar haqida emas, o'zgarish kerakmi-yo'qmi haqida. Kalitda tekshirilsin (B va D ni muhokama qiling).

readings.title: Practice 1: Mend and make do — the new culture of repair
readings.qtype: Multiple choice (1–5) + Yes / No / Not Given (6–10) + Sentence endings (11–14)
readings.source: Jony Academy — yangi matn (Passage 3 darajasi)
text: For most of human history, clothes were far too valuable to throw away. A shirt would be patched when it tore, its collar would be turned when it became worn, and when it could no longer be repaired, the fabric would be cut up to make cleaning cloths or quilts. It was only in the second half of the twentieth century, as mass production made garments cheap, that repair began to disappear from ordinary homes. Today, however, a growing number of people are picking up needles again, and in my view this is one of the most encouraging developments in fashion for decades.

The movement has several sources. Environmental concern is the most obvious. Textile production uses large amounts of water and energy, and much discarded clothing ends up in landfill or is burned. Repairing a garment extends its life, and every extra year of wear reduces the need to make a new one. Yet it would be wrong to see mending simply as an environmental duty. Many of the people who attend repair workshops say that they come for the pleasure of making something with their hands, and for the company of others who share the same interest. Some also point out that a well-repaired garment often fits better than a new one, because it has already taken the shape of its owner.

The style of repair has changed too. Traditional mending aimed to be invisible: a skilled darner could fix a hole in a sock so neatly that it could hardly be seen. Much contemporary mending does the opposite. 'Visible mending' uses contrasting threads, bright patches and decorative stitches to draw attention to the repair. Its supporters argue that a repair is part of a garment's history and should be celebrated rather than hidden. Some of the techniques they use are borrowed from other cultures; Japanese sashiko stitching, which was originally a way of strengthening the clothes of farmers and fishermen, is particularly popular.

Retailers have noticed. Several outdoor clothing companies now offer repair services for their own products, and a few will repair items bought many years earlier free of charge. Cynics suggest that these schemes are mainly a form of marketing, designed to make brands look responsible while they continue to sell more new products than ever. There is some truth in this, but I think the criticism is too harsh: a jacket that is repaired is a jacket that is not replaced, whatever the company's motives may be.

The greatest obstacle to repair is not cost but skill. Sewing was once taught routinely in schools, but in many countries it disappeared from the curriculum decades ago. As a result, many adults today cannot sew on a button, let alone replace a zip. Community repair cafés, where volunteers show visitors how to fix their own clothes and household objects, are trying to fill this gap. Their organisers stress that the aim is not to repair things for people but to teach them to do it themselves, so that they will not need to come back with the same problem.

Design matters as well. Many cheap garments are made in ways that make repair difficult: seams are narrow, fabrics are thin, and some parts are glued rather than sewn. A number of designers are now thinking about repair from the start, for example by using standard buttons and zips that can easily be replaced, or by leaving extra fabric inside the seams so that a garment can be let out if the owner's size changes. Such details add little to the cost of production but can greatly extend a garment's life.

It would be naive to expect mending alone to solve the problems created by the fashion industry. Most people will continue to buy new clothes, and the volume of production is still rising. But the return of repair represents a change in attitude that deserves to be taken seriously. A person who has spent an evening patching a favourite pair of jeans is unlikely to think of clothes as disposable ever again.

readings.title: Practice 2: Ikat — the cloud-tied cloth of Central Asia
readings.qtype: Multiple choice (1–5) + Yes / No / Not Given (6–10) + Sentence endings (11–14)
readings.source: Jony Academy — yangi matn (Passage 3 darajasi)
text: Few textiles are as instantly recognisable as ikat. Its bold patterns, in which one colour seems to melt into the next, can be found on cushions, bags and dresses in shops around the world. Yet many of the people who buy these products have no idea how the original fabric is made, or that one of its great historic centres lies in the Fergana Valley of Uzbekistan. In my view, this lack of awareness is a pity, because the story behind the cloth is at least as remarkable as its appearance.

The name ikat comes from a Malay word meaning 'to tie', and it describes the key stage of the process. Before any weaving takes place, bundles of thread are stretched out and tightly bound in certain places so that dye cannot reach them. The bundles are then dyed, the bindings are removed, and the process is repeated for each new colour. Because the dye always spreads a little under the bindings, the edges of the pattern are never perfectly sharp. This slight blurring, which a machine would treat as a fault, is exactly what gives ikat its character.

In Central Asia the technique is known as abrbandi, from a Persian word for 'cloud' — a reference to the soft, cloud-like edges of the designs. Traditionally, different specialists were responsible for each stage of production. One person designed the pattern and tied the threads, another prepared the dyes, and a third did the weaving. Dyeing with indigo was often carried out by a separate group of craftsmen who worked only with that colour. A single length of fine cloth could therefore pass through many pairs of hands before it was finished. The patterns themselves carried meaning. Some designs are said to represent natural forms such as pomegranates, tulips or rams' horns, while others were believed to protect the wearer from harm. Because each workshop developed its own variations, experienced buyers could often tell where a piece of cloth had been made simply by looking at it.

Two main types of fabric were produced. Khan-atlas is made entirely of silk and has a smooth, shining surface, while adras combines silk with cotton, which makes it heavier and more hard-wearing. In the nineteenth century, robes made from these fabrics were worn by wealthy people as a sign of their status, and they were also given as gifts on important occasions such as weddings.

During the twentieth century, much production moved into large factories, and many traditional skills were in danger of being lost. Factory ikat was cheaper, but the designs became simpler, synthetic dyes replaced natural ones and the quality of the cloth declined. It was only towards the end of the century that a serious revival began, as craftspeople in Margilan and elsewhere reopened small workshops, relearned older techniques and began to train apprentices. Today visitors can watch the whole process, from the unwinding of silk cocoons to the finished cloth.

International interest has brought both opportunities and problems. Fashion designers in Europe and America have repeatedly used ikat patterns in their collections, and this has helped to create new markets for hand-woven fabrics. Designers from Uzbekistan itself have also begun to present ikat garments at international fashion events. However, much of what is sold as 'ikat' in Western shops is in fact printed, with the pattern simply copied onto the surface of ordinary cloth. Such products are not dishonest in themselves, but I believe customers deserve to be told clearly what they are buying.

The future of the craft will depend on whether it can remain both authentic and profitable. Some weavers have started to experiment with new colours and lighter fabrics that suit modern tastes, and a few now sell directly to customers online. Purists object that this is a betrayal of tradition. I do not share this view: traditions have always changed, and a craft that refuses to adapt is more likely to die than one that welcomes new ideas.

readings.title: Practice 3 (uyga): Fast fashion — counting the cost
readings.qtype: Multiple choice (1–5) + Yes / No / Not Given (6–10) + Sentence endings (11–14)
readings.source: Jony Academy — yangi matn (Passage 3 darajasi), uy vazifasi
text: Over the past three decades, the way people buy clothes has changed dramatically. Large retailers now introduce new designs not twice a year, as was once the norm, but every few weeks, and prices have fallen so low that a T-shirt can cost less than a sandwich. This model, known as 'fast fashion', has made fashionable clothing available to almost everyone. It has also, I would argue, encouraged us to treat clothes as if they were disposable.

The speed of the system depends on close links between design and production. When a new style appears on a catwalk or is worn by a celebrity, designers working for fast-fashion brands can produce a similar garment and have it in shops within a few weeks. Sales figures are checked daily, so that popular items can be reordered quickly and unpopular ones withdrawn. From a business point of view, the system is remarkably efficient: it greatly reduces the risk of producing large quantities of clothes that nobody wants to buy. Some companies first produce small trial batches of a new design and place larger orders only once they see how well it sells.

The environmental costs, however, are considerable. Growing cotton requires large amounts of water and, in many regions, pesticides. Synthetic fibres such as polyester are made from oil, and when they are washed, they release tiny plastic fibres that can end up in rivers and seas. Estimates of the industry's total contribution to global carbon emissions vary widely, and some of the figures quoted in the media are, in my opinion, unreliable. Nevertheless, there is no serious doubt that the overall impact is large.

Social concerns have also been raised. Much clothing is produced in countries where wages are low and working conditions can be poor. A number of major brands have introduced codes of conduct for their suppliers, and some publish lists of the factories they use. Critics argue, however, that such measures are hard to enforce, because production is often passed on to smaller workshops that are rarely inspected.

The low price of fast fashion also affects how long clothes are kept. Many garments are worn only a handful of times before being thrown away or pushed to the back of a wardrobe. When clothes cost so little, there is little reason to look after them carefully or to have them repaired, and a small fault such as a broken zip can be enough to end a garment's life.

Consumers are often blamed for the situation, but this seems to me only partly fair. Surveys suggest that many shoppers say they care about how their clothes are made, yet continue to choose the cheapest option. This gap between attitudes and behaviour is not simply hypocrisy: it can be very difficult for an ordinary shopper to find reliable information about a garment's origins. Labels usually state only the country where it was finally put together, not where the cotton was grown or the fabric was woven.

Several alternatives to fast fashion are now being tested. Clothing rental services allow customers to wear an outfit for a special occasion and then return it. Second-hand clothing, once associated mainly with charity shops, is now bought and sold in large quantities online. Some brands have begun to collect used garments in their stores, promising to recycle them. Recycling textiles, however, is technically difficult, particularly when fabrics are made from a mixture of fibres, and only a small proportion of the clothing collected is actually turned into new fibre.

Ultimately, the most effective change may also be the simplest: buying fewer clothes and wearing them for longer. This does not mean giving up an interest in fashion. On the contrary, choosing a smaller number of well-made garments and combining them in different ways requires more thought about style, not less. It also means paying more attention to how clothes are washed and stored, since good care can add years to a garment's life.
paraphrases: encouraged us to treat clothes as if they were disposable
avoids producing too many unwanted clothes
reduces the risk of producing large quantities of clothes that nobody wants
the country where the garment was finally made
the country where it was finally put together
requires more thought about style, not less

5 What problem with textile recycling is mentioned? A) Shops refuse to accept old clothes. B) Recycled fibre is too expensive. C) Few people bring their clothes to be collected. D) Clothes made from mixed fibres are hard to recycle.
why: "It has also, I would argue, encouraged us to treat clothes as if they were disposable." A — teskari (narxlar tushgan); D — "available to almost everyone".
"It greatly reduces the risk of producing large quantities of clothes that nobody wants to buy." A — tuzoq: celebrity faqat yangi uslub manbai sifatida tilga olingan.
"Some of the figures quoted in the media are, in my opinion, unreliable." C — "vary widely" — teskari.
"Production is often passed on to smaller workshops that are rarely inspected." A — tuzoq: ba'zi brendlar ro'yxatni e'lon qiladi.
"Recycling textiles ... is technically difficult, particularly when fabrics are made from a mixture of fibres."

intro: Section 4 — imtihonning oxirgi qismi: bitta ma'ruzachi akademik mavzuda gapiradi (tarix, fan, dizayn). Boshqa section'lardan farqi — o'rtada PAUZA YO'Q: 10 savolni oldindan o'qib olasiz va audio oxirigacha to'xtamaydi.
Eng ko'p uchraydigan savol turi — sentence completion yoki note completion. Bugungi ikkala kitob mashqida ham: "Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer."

TAYYORLANISH (45 soniya). Har gapda: 1) kalit so'zni tagiga chizing (sashiko means, in the beginning, warm fabrics, firemen...); 2) bo'shliqqa qanday so'z kerak — ot, ko'plikdagi ot, sifat, nom, sana; 3) gapning boshidagi vaqt belgisi (In the past, In the 1930s, Nowadays) — ma'ruza tartibini ko'rsatadi.

PARAPHRASE: savoldagi so'z audioda boshqacha aytiladi — "means" = "translates as", "not needed" = "no longer necessary", "old clothes" = "ancient garments". Lekin JAVOBNING O'ZI audiodagi aynan so'z bo'ladi (Exam advice: "You will hear the exact word(s) you need").

SIGNAL SO'ZLAR ma'ruzada yangi qism boshlanganini bildiradi: "Now, what does that word mean?", "So the point here is...", "Then, in 1895...", "Now, there are exhibitions...". Bitta savolni o'tkazib yuborsangiz, signal so'zni kutib, keyingi savolga o'ting.

TUZOQLAR: ma'ruzachi bo'shliqqa mos keladigan bir necha so'z aytadi. Masalan, "decorative design" avval aytiladi, lekin 2-savolda "rather than decorative" — demak javob "functional". Savoldagi so'z bo'shliq ichida takrorlanmaydi.
TRANSFER: so'z chegarasi (TWO WORDS — "many layers" bo'ladi, "many layers of cloth" bo'lmaydi), imlo, ko'plik -s. Gapni javob bilan birga o'qing — grammatik jihatdan to'g'rimi?
formulas: vaqt belgilari: In the past, In the 1930s
Now... / So the point here is...
presentation: Section 4 da pauza bo'lmasa, qachon o'qiyman?
Audio boshlanishidan oldin berilgan vaqtda (odatda 45 soniya) — 10 savolning hammasini o'qing.
Javobni o'z so'zim bilan yozsam bo'ladimi?
Yo'q. Javob audiodagi aynan so'z. Paraphrase faqat savol gapida bo'ladi.
"Firemen" yoki "fire men" — qaysi biri to'g'ri?
Kalitda ikkalasi qabul qilinadi. Lekin imlo xatosi ("firemans") — 0 ball.
Ikkita javob eshitdim, qaysini yozaman?
Gapning qolgan qismiga mos kelganini: "rather than decorative" — demak, bo'shliqda "decorative" ning teskarisi.
"Many layers" yozsam bo'ladimi yoki faqat "layers"?
Ikkalasi ham to'g'ri — ikki so'z chegarasi ichida. Kalitda (many) layers.
Bitta savolni o'tkazib yubordim.
To'xtamang. Keyingi savol kalit so'zini tinglang; oxirida bo'sh joyga mantiqiy taxmin yozing.

tasks.title: Questions 1–10
tasks.type: Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer.
tasks.instr: Savollar ma'ruza tartibida. Pauza yo'q — bitta savolni o'tkazib yuborsangiz, keyingisining kalit so'zini kuting.
items: 1 The word sashiko means '___'.
2 In the beginning, sashiko was ___ rather than decorative.
3 In the past, warm fabrics such as ___ were not available in some parts of Japan.
4 Warm clothes were produced by using sashiko to join ___ of material.
5 Traditional sashiko designs included one called '___'.
6 In the towns of ancient Japan, workers such as ___ wore sashiko garments.
7 It used to be essential for someone married to a ___ to know how to do sashiko.
8 Sashiko was not needed when ___ began in northern Japan.
9 Modern sashiko patterns include stripes and ___ shapes.
10 Unfortunately, ___ are not as interested in old clothes as in other ancient craft objects.
why: "It translates as 'little stitches'." Translates as = means.
"Its Japanese origins were much more functional than this." Tuzoq: avval "decorative design" aytiladi — lekin gapda "rather than decorative".
"There were no sheep in Japan at this time, so, er, no wool either." Tuzoq: "asa" — mahalliy mato, "hard-wearing but not very warm".
"They solved the problem of warmth by stitching together many layers of this cloth." Stitching together = join.
"They used designs based on traditional Japanese patterns that had their own names, such as 'sea wave'."
"In Japanese towns, firemen dressed for duty in sashiko-stitched garments." Tuzoq: "country people" va savat tashuvchilar — bular qishloqda.
"The wife of someone like a farmer, for instance, had to spend time making clothes." Someone married to a farmer = the wife of a farmer.
"Sashiko was no longer necessary because rail travel reached northern Japan." "Warm textiles could then be imported" — sabab, lekin javob emas.
"The stitches can be arranged to produce a diamond effect." "Vertical and horizontal stripes" savolda allaqachon bor.
"Many of them have been thrown away, rather than getting the attention of collectors." Tuzoq: "old pots and ceramics" — boshqa hunar buyumlari.
tasks.note: 2- va 3-savollar — darsning asosiy tuzoq misollari: ma'ruzachi bo'shliqqa mos keladigan boshqa so'zni (decorative, asa) avval aytadi. Gapning qolgan qismi (rather than..., warm) to'g'ri javobni tanlashga yordam beradi.

why: "The general belief is that the word 'jeans' comes from Genoa in Italy, where sailors wore clothes made from a material called jean."

"Denim was woven with one coloured thread and one white thread, while jean was woven with two coloured threads." Tuzoq: "stronger and more expensive" — bu ham farq, lekin gapdagi "used to create them" ga mos emas.
"Those worn by workers on plantations." Place of work = plantations.
"His first name was Leob, that's L-E-O-B. Later, he changed it to Levi." Originally — Leob. Tuzoq: Levi.
"The pockets tore away from them very easily."
"This was for metal rivets to hold the pockets..." va "these metal fasteners, made of copper". Ikkalasi ham qabul qilinadi.
"This showed a pair of these trousers being pulled between two horses."
"The roots of this lie in the cowboy movies of the 1930s." Tuzoq: "Hollywood" — lekin gapda "characters in ___".
"American soldiers wore them when they were off duty."
"Teenagers didn't call the clothes 'waist overalls', they gave them a new name — 'jean pants'." Tuzoq: "waist overalls" — eski nom.

listenings.title: Jony Academy: The story of the zip (Q1–10)
intro: Dizayn tarixi kursidan ma'ruza: kundalik buyum — zamok (zip) qanday paydo bo'lgan va ommalashgan. Ustoz skriptni ma'ruza tezligida BIR MARTA o'qiydi, pauzasiz.
Ko'rsatma: Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer. O'quvchilarga 45 soniya tayyorlanish vaqti beriladi.
transcript: LECTURER: Good afternoon, everyone. In today's session on the history of design, I want to look at an object that most of us use dozens of times a day without thinking about it — the zip, or, as Americans call it, the zipper.

LECTURER: The story begins in the United States in the 1890s, with an engineer called Whitcomb Judson. Now, you might expect that he was trying to improve trousers or jackets, but in fact his invention was meant for shoes. At that time, fashionable shoes were often fastened with long rows of buttons or laces, and doing them up took a lot of time. Judson called his device a 'clasp locker', and it was shown to the public at the World's Fair in Chicago in 1893.

LECTURER: Unfortunately, it wasn't a great success. The early versions were rather heavy, and they weren't cheap, but the main problem was that they were unreliable — they had a habit of springing open at the worst possible moment.

LECTURER: The real breakthrough came in 1913, when a Swedish-born engineer, Gideon Sundback, redesigned the fastener. Instead of the old hooks and eyes, he used small metal teeth, and he greatly increased the number of teeth on each side, so the two sides held together firmly. This is basically the design we still use today.

LECTURER: Interestingly, the first big customers were not fashion houses at all. During the First World War, the new fasteners were sewn into flying suits for pilots, and they were also used on money belts, where security mattered more than appearance.

LECTURER: Now, where does the word 'zipper' come from? It was introduced in the 1920s by a rubber company, B. F. Goodrich, which put the fasteners on a new line of rubber boots. Someone at the company felt that the name matched the sound the fastener made as it was pulled up and down — and the name stuck.

LECTURER: In the 1930s, manufacturers began a campaign aimed at parents. Safety was mentioned, and so was cost, but the main message was independence: with zips on their clothing, children would be able to dress themselves without an adult's help.

LECTURER: Men's trousers were a harder battle. Many tailors preferred buttons, and some customers simply didn't trust the new fastener. The turning point came in 1937, when French fashion designers praised the zip in men's trousers, and a well-known men's magazine described it as the newest idea in tailoring.

LECTURER: So, what about today? Zips are made in many countries, and China, for example, produces an enormous number of them. However, the world's largest single manufacturer of zips is a company from Japan, which began as a small workshop in the 1930s.

LECTURER: Finally, designers today often treat the zip not just as something practical, but as a decorative feature. A bright or oversized zip can become the focus of a whole jacket or bag. Right, in the next part of the lecture, I'm going to look at another everyday fastener — the button.

7 In the 1930s, parents were told that zips would help children to ___ without an adult.
8 Zips in men's trousers were accepted after French ___ praised them in 1937.
9 The largest zip manufacturer in the world today comes from ___.
10 Some modern designers use the zip as a ___ feature.
why: "In fact his invention was meant for shoes." Tuzoq: "trousers or jackets" — ma'ruzachi kutilgan javobni rad etadi.
"The main problem was that they were unreliable." Tuzoq: "heavy" va "weren't cheap" — ular ham aytiladi, lekin "main problem" emas.
"He greatly increased the number of teeth on each side." Tuzoq: "hooks and eyes" — eski dizayn.
"The new fasteners were sewn into flying suits for pilots." Tuzoq: "money belts" — uchuvchilar uchun emas.
"The name matched the sound the fastener made."
"Put the fasteners on a new line of rubber boots."
"Children would be able to dress themselves without an adult's help." Tuzoq: "safety" va "cost" — asosiy xabar emas.
"When French fashion designers praised the zip in men's trousers." Tuzoq: "tailors" — ular tugmani afzal ko'rgan.
"The world's largest single manufacturer of zips is a company from Japan." Tuzoq: "China" — ko'p ishlab chiqaradi, lekin eng katta bitta kompaniya emas.
"As a decorative feature." Tuzoq: "practical" — "not just".
tasks.note: O'qish qoidasi: ustoz skriptni ma'ruza tezligida, pauzasiz o'qiydi; tuzoq so'zlarni (trousers, heavy, hooks, China) ham aniq talaffuz qiladi. Tekshiruvda 2-, 7- va 9-savollarni skript bilan ko'rsating: bitta gapda bir nechta variant eshitiladi.

Ikkinchi vazifa — shadowing: Student's Book Track 14 dan 1 daqiqalik parchani (sashiko'ning kelib chiqishi haqidagi qism) ma'ruzachi bilan birga, bir xil tezlikda takrorlang. Ovozli xabarni guruhga yuboring.

Uchinchi vazifa — xatolar daftari va paraphrase ro'yxati: bugungi har xato javobni sababi bilan yozing (paraphrase / tuzoq / imlo / so'z chegarasi) va darsdagi 10 ta paraphrase juftligini (translates as = means va h.k.) daftarga ko'chiring.

lessons.title: Mock test 2 (yakuniy): 8 unitdan keyin — to'liq imtihon va natijalar tahlili
lessons.grammar_topic: To'liq mockni o'tkazish (Listening 30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa — havola orqali kompyuterda) va natijani savol turlari bo'yicha Unit 1–8 ga bog'lab tahlil qilish
lessons.vocab_topic: Xom ball va band, olti xato sababi, savol turi bo'yicha naqsh, unitga qaytish, ikki haftalik reja
lessons.book_ref: Jony Academy CRM mock bazasi — mock havolasi guruh test ekranidan ochiladi, Listening skriptini examiner ovoz chiqarib o'qiydi; examiner javoblar varaqasi har savol bo'yicha o'quvchining javobi, to'g'ri javob va mavzu belgisini ko'rsatadi; band rasmiy xom ball — band jadvali bo'yicha avtomatik qo'yiladi.
objectives: To'liq mockni tartib bilan o'tkazish: xona va ekran tayyorligi, qoidalar, Listening skriptini examiner o'qishi, tugatgan o'quvchi bilan ishlash.
To'liq qog'oz (30 + 60 + 60 = 150 daqiqa) bitta 120 daqiqalik darsga sig'masligini bilish: bu dars uning ramkasi.
O'z natijasini o'qish: xom ball, band va qaysi bo'lim o'rtachani pastga tortgani.
Har xato javobni olti sababdan bittasiga ajratish.
Xatolarni savol turi bo'yicha guruhlab, Unit 1–8 dagi qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligini aniqlash.
Maqsad bilan solishtirish (6.0 va undan yuqori: Listening 23+, Reading 23+ (40 dan)) va ikki haftalik aniq reja yozish.
materials: Chop etilgan ism ro'yxati: kim qaysi kompyuterda o'tirgani va kim tugatgani belgilanadi.
Ustoz ekranida examiner Listening skripti — faqat ustozda, o'quvchiga ko'rsatilmaydi.
Har stolda zaxira qog'oz va qalam: Listening paytida ism, raqam va sanalar qoralama qilinadi.
Doskada xona qoidalari va qolgan vaqt; tahlil qismida — Listening va Reading xom ball — band jadvallari.
Har o'quvchiga "Olti sabab" jadvali va "Savol turi → Unit" xaritasi (quyidagi 3-mashq jadvali) chop etilgan holda.
Har o'quvchiga "Ikki haftalik reja" varaqasi — 6 qator, oxirida ustoz imzosi uchun joy.
Proyektor: tahlilda examiner javoblar varaqasi guruh test ekrani orqali ochiladi.
timeline: Mock oldidan: xona va ekran tayyorligi
Kompyuterlar tekshiriladi, havola guruh test ekranidan ochiladi, examiner skripti ustoz ekranida, ism ro'yxati va zaxira qog'oz tarqatiladi.
Joylashtirish va xona qoidalari
Telefon sumkaga; sahifadan chiqish tizimda sanalishi ovoz chiqarib aytiladi; savol bo'lsa qo'l ko'tariladi.
Listeningni o'tkazish
Examiner Part 1–4 ni ovoz chiqarib BIR MARTA o'qiydi; skript faqat examiner ekranida.
Reading va Writing yurganda ustoz
Xona kuzatiladi, mazmun bo'yicha yordam berilmaydi, qolgan vaqt doskaga yozib boriladi.
Natijaning tushishi
Xom ball avtomatik bandga aylanib guruh jurnaliga tushadi; examiner javoblar varaqasi ochiladi.
Natijani ochish
Har o'quvchi xom ball va bandini daftariga yozadi va maqsad bilan solishtiradi (6.0 va undan yuqori: Listening 23+, Reading 23+ (40 dan)).
Xom ball — band jadvali
Doskada ikkala jadval; bitta savol yarim bandni o'zgartirishi ko'rsatiladi (2-mashq).
Olti sabab
Har sababga bitta tanish misol (1-mashq); sabablar jadvali tarqatiladi.
Javoblar varaqasi: Listening
Savol-savol o'qiladi, har xatoga sabab raqami va Section turi yoziladi.
Javoblar varaqasi: Reading
Passage bo'yicha ketma-ket; har xatoga sabab raqami va savol turi yoziladi.
Savol turi → Unit xaritasi
Xatolar savol turi bo'yicha guruhlanadi va Unit 1–8 dagi qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligi topiladi (3-mashq).
Ikki haftalik reja
Har kim eng katta ikki naqsh bo'yicha 6 qatorli reja yozadi; juftlik o'qib tekshiradi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Reja ustozga ko'rsatiladi va imzolanadi; xatolar daftari uyda to'ldiriladi.

intro: Bu dars ikki qismdan iborat: avval to'liq mock, keyin natijalarni savol-savol tahlil qilish. Yangi mavzu yo'q — bugun Unit 1–8 da o'rganilgan savol turlari kombinatsiyalari imtihon sharoitida o'lchanadi.

Mock havolasi guruh test ekranidan ochiladi, o'quvchilar kompyuterda ishlaydi. Listening 30, Reading 60, Writing 60 daqiqa — jami 150 daqiqa, ya'ni to'liq qog'oz bitta darsga sig'maydi: u shu slotdan tashqarida yoki ikki o'tirishda ishlanadi, bu dars esa uning ramkasi.
Listeningda yozuv qo'yilmaydi: skriptni EXAMINER ovoz chiqarib, bir marta va bir tekis tezlikda o'qiydi. Skript faqat examiner ekranida turadi.

Natija ikki raqam: XOM BALL (40 dan nechta) va BAND. Listening va Reading jadvallari bir xil emas: 26 ta to'g'ri javob Listeningda 6.5, Academic Readingda 6.0. Bitta savol ko'pincha yarim bandni o'zgartiradi — bo'sh javob qoldirmang.

Olti sabab: 1) eshitmadim / topa olmadim; 2) eshitdim, lekin xato yozdim (imlo, ko'plik, raqam); 3) vaqt yetmadi; 4) savol turini noto'g'ri tushundim (so'z limiti, NOT GIVEN va FALSE farqi, TWO letters); 5) taxmin qildim; 6) bilardim, lekin javobni o'zgartirdim.

6.0 ning yangiligi — tahlil SAVOL TURI bo'yicha. Har xatoning yonida savol turi yoziladi va "Savol turi → Unit" xaritasidan qaysi darsga qaytish kerakligi topiladi. Masalan, Matching headings da 3 ta xato — Unit 2 (3-dars) readinglari va Practice 1–3 qayta ishlanadi.
Kombinatsiya xatosini alohida belgilang: agar bir passage'da ikkinchi savol turiga vaqt yetmagan bo'lsa (3-sabab), muammo tur emas — xarita usuli va vaqt taqsimoti.
Maqsad: 6.0 va undan yuqori: Listening 23+, Reading 23+ (40 dan). Maqsaddan past bo'lim — ikki haftalik rejaning birinchi qatori.
presentation: Mock nega kerak, darslar yetmaydimi?
Darsda har tur alohida ishlanadi; mockda hammasi aralash va vaqt bilan. Kombinatsiya ko'nikmasi faqat shu yerda o'lchanadi.
Ballim past chiqdi. Nima qilaman?
Avval sabablarni sanang. Ko'pincha 2-sabab (imlo, raqam) — bu eng tez tuzaladigan xato.
Xatolarim har xil turlarda. Qayerdan boshlayman?
Eng ko'p xato bo'lgan ikki turdan. Xaritadan ularning darsini toping.
Listening skriptini keyin berasizmi?
Yo'q. Tahlil faqat javoblar varaqasi orqali, skript o'quvchiga berilmaydi.
Vaqt yetmadi — bu qaysi sabab?
3-sabab. Davosi — xarita usuli va har passage uchun 20 daqiqa qoidasi (Unit 1).
Writingni ham tahlil qilamizmi?
Writing alohida baholanadi; bu darsning tahlili Listening va Readingga qaratilgan.
notes: Natijalarni ochishdan oldin o'quvchilarga eslating: mock — o'lchov, jazo emas. Maqsad — keyingi ikki haftada qaysi darsga qaytishni bilish.
Tahlil qismida ustoz ham guruh bo'yicha umumiy naqshni yozib oladi: agar guruhning yarmi bitta turda xato qilgan bo'lsa, o'sha unit keyingi haftada sinfda qayta ko'riladi.

Bu yakuniy mock: natija guruhning IELTS 6.0 kursini tugatganini ko'rsatadi. Maqsadga yetmagan o'quvchi uchun xaritadagi 2 ta eng zaif dars bo'yicha individual reja tuziladi va Writing Task 1 bilan parallel olib boriladi.

Birinchi vazifa — xatolar daftari: har xato uchun oltita ustun — savol raqami, sizning javobingiz, to'g'ri javob, savol turi, sabab raqami va qaytiladigan dars. Oxirida har sabab va har tur necha marta chiqqanini sanang.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (1): Task 1 bilan tanishuv va 4 baholash mezoni
lessons.grammar_topic: Academic Writing Task 1: talablar (150 so'z, 20 daqiqa), savol turlari va examiner baholaydigan 4 mezon
lessons.vocab_topic: Task 1 tili: grafik, jadval, jarayon va xaritani tasvirlash uchun asosiy so'zlar
lessons.book_ref: Ustoz bergan slaydlar: "Mastering IELTS Writing: Task 1 (Academic)", 1–14-slaydlar (Section 1: General Overview).
objectives: Task 1 ning asosiy talablarini bilish: kamida 150 so'z, 20 daqiqa, Task 2 ning yarmicha ball, fikr emas — ma'lumotni tasvirlash.
Task 1 savolini ko'rib, turini aniqlash: grafik (line, bar, pie), jadval, jarayon (process) yoki xarita (map); bir nechta grafik ham bo'lishi mumkin.
Examiner baholaydigan 4 mezonni o'z so'zi bilan tushuntira olish: Task Achievement, Coherence and Cohesion, Lexical Resource, Grammatical Range and Accuracy.
Band 7 uchun har mezonda nima kerakligini bilish — ayniqsa aniq OVERVIEW (umumiy tendensiya) va asosiy xususiyatlarni tanlash.
Namuna javobda har mezon qayerda ko'rinishini topa olish.
materials: Slaydlar 1–14 (quyidagi Reading bo'limida ikki rasm) — proyektorda ko'rsatiladi.
Namuna javob (Jony Academy) va uning jadvali — har o'quvchiga chop etilgan, to'rt rangli marker bilan (har mezonga bitta rang).
Doskada to'rt ustun: TA — CC — LR — GRA; dars davomida har ustunga misollar yozib boriladi.
Soat: Task 1 uchun 20 daqiqa normasi doskaga yoziladi.
timeline: Kirish
Savol: "Task 2 ni bilasiz. Task 1 undan nimasi bilan farq qiladi?" — javoblar doskaga.
Task 1 nima? (slaydlar 1–3)
150 so'z, 20 daqiqa, yarim ball, grafik / jadval / jarayon / xarita. O'quvchilar daftarga 5 ta asosiy faktni yozadi.
To'rt misol (slaydlar 4–7)
Har misolda: bu qaysi tur? vaqt bormi? nimani solishtirish kerak? (1-mashq bilan birga).
To'rt mezon (slaydlar 8–13)
Har mezon: rasmiy talab → "boshqacha aytganda" → bitta tipik xato. Doskadagi to'rt ustun to'ldiriladi.
Band descriptor xulosasi (slayd 14)
O'quvchilar har mezondan bittadan eng muhim talabni tanlab aytadi.
Namuna javob tahlili
Jony Academy namunasi o'qiladi; o'quvchilar to'rt rang bilan mezonlarni belgilaydi.
Sinf mashqlari
2-mashq (qaysi mezon?) va 3-mashq (Task 1 da nima bo'lmaydi?).
Xulosa va vazifa
Uyga: jadval bo'yicha kirish + overview va mezonlar ro'yxati bilan o'z-o'zini tekshirish.

intro: Academic Writing Task 1 — grafik, jadval, jarayon yoki xarita berilgan qisqa hisobot. Kamida 150 so'z, tavsiya etilgan vaqt 20 daqiqa. Task 2 ikki barobar ko'p ball beradi, shuning uchun Task 1 ga 20 daqiqadan ortiq vaqt sarflamang.

Savol har doim bir xil ko'rsatma bilan tugaydi: "Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant." Ya'ni uchta ish: 1) ASOSIY xususiyatlarni TANLASH (hamma raqamni emas); 2) ularni tasvirlash; 3) solishtirish.
To'rt tur: grafik (line, bar, pie), jadval, jarayon (process) va xarita (map). Ba'zan ikkita grafik yoki grafik + jadval birga beriladi (slayd 4 dagi Yaman va Italiya pie chartlari).
Task 1 da FIKR yo'q: "I think", "in my opinion", sabab va taxminlar ("because people are lazier now") yozilmaydi. Faqat ko'rsatilgan ma'lumot.
TASK ACHIEVEMENT: savoldagi hamma narsani qamrash, aniq OVERVIEW (umumiy tendensiya yoki eng katta farq) va asosiy xususiyatlarni aniq tasvirlash. Overview'siz javob odatda Band 5 dan oshmaydi.
COHERENCE AND COHESION: mantiqiy tartib (kirish → overview → tafsilotlar) va bog'lovchilar (however, whereas, by contrast, at this point) — lekin ortiqcha emas.
LEXICAL RESOURCE: sinonimlar va aniqlik ("nice" emas, "a sharp rise"), kollokatsiyalar ("rise sharply", "a slight fall"). Bir so'zni takrorlamaslik uchun paraphrase.
GRAMMATICAL RANGE AND ACCURACY: oddiy va murakkab gaplar aralash, gaplarning yarmidan ko'pi xatosiz, vergul va nuqta to'g'ri.
formulas: Hammasini qamrash, aniq overview, asosiy xususiyatlar
"Overall, TV viewing fell sharply, while social media became the most popular activity."
Overview yo'q; hamma raqamni ketma-ket sanash
"The number is big", bir so'zni 5 marta takrorlash
"..., which was three times the figure for social media"
presentation: 150 so'zdan ko'p yozsam ball oshadimi?
Yo'q. 160–190 so'z yetarli. Uzunroq javob — ko'proq xato ehtimoli va Task 2 ga kam vaqt.
Hamma raqamni yozishim kerakmi?
Yo'q. "Selecting" — tanlash. Eng katta, eng kichik, eng ko'p o'zgargan va istisnolarni yozing.
Xulosa (conclusion) yozamanmi?
Task 1 da overview yetarli. Fikrli xulosa yozmang.
Nega bunday bo'lganini tushuntirsam-chi?
Kerak emas va xato: grafikda sabab ko'rsatilmagan. Bu Task Achievement ni pasaytiradi.
Overview qayerda turadi?
Odatda kirishdan keyin, ikkinchi xatboshida — examiner uni darhol ko'radi (keyingi darsda batafsil).
Qaysi mezon eng muhim?
To'rttasi teng (har biri 25%). Lekin Task 1 da eng ko'p ball overview va tanlash (Task Achievement) da yo'qotiladi.
notes: Bu dars — Writing Task 1 turkumining kirishi. Slaydlar ingliz tilida; har slayddan keyin o'quvchi o'z so'zi bilan o'zbekcha yoki inglizcha qayta aytsin.
To'rt mezonni devorga ilib qo'ying — keyingi Writing darslarida har tekshiruv shu to'rt ustun bo'yicha bo'ladi.
Namuna javobdagi ma'lumotlar mashq uchun to'qilgan; o'quvchilarga buni aytib qo'ying.

how: CORE — Task 1 ning har javobida keladigan so'zlar; STRONG — solishtirish va o'zgarish; SUPER — Band 7 uchun aniq iboralar.
Har so'z bilan namuna jadval (quyida) haqida bitta gap tuzing.

Ko'rsatkichlar mos ravishda 5 va 6 soat edi.

Bu davr mobaynida sport kam o'zgardi.

The most striking change was the fall in TV viewing.

Televizor va ijtimoiy tarmoqlar mashhurligida teskari o'zgarish bo'ldi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: Bu qaysi tur? Vaqt bormi?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz savol boshini o'qiydi. O'quvchilar ayting: 1) turi (line / bar / pie / table / process / map); 2) vaqt o'zgarishi bormi; 3) asosan nimani solishtirish kerak.
items: The graph shows the number of visitors to three museums in London between 2000 and 2020.
The pie charts give information about the ages of the populations of Yemen and Italy in 2000 and projections for 2050.
The table gives information about the underground railway systems in six cities.
The two maps show an island before and after the construction of some tourist facilities.
The diagrams show the stages and equipment used in the cement-making process.
The bar chart compares the average monthly rainfall in four cities.
answers: line graph — vaqt bor; muzeylar o'zgarishi va solishtiruvi
pie chart (bir nechta) — vaqt bor (2000 → 2050); yosh guruhlari ulushi, ikki davlat
table — vaqt yo'q; shaharlar orasidagi farq
map — "oldin va keyin"; nima qo'shildi, nima o'zgardi
process — vaqt emas, BOSQICHLAR; boshi va oxiri
bar chart — vaqt yo'q; shaharlar orasidagi farq
why: "between 2000 and 2020" — vaqt oralig'i, line graph odatiy.
Slayd 4 dagi misol. Ikki davlat + ikki yil = to'rtta pie; solishtirish ikki yo'nalishda.
Slayd 5 dagi misol. Raqamlar ustunlarda; eng katta va eng kichikni tanlash kerak.
Slayd 6 dagi misol. Xaritada — joylashuv va o'zgarish tili (was built, was replaced).
Slayd 7 dagi misol. Jarayonda passiv (is heated, is mixed) va bosqich bog'lovchilari.
Vaqt yo'q — o'sish/kamayish emas, solishtirish tili (higher than, the lowest).

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Bu xato qaysi mezonga ta'sir qiladi?
class_ex.instr: Ustoz xatoni o'qiydi. O'quvchi mezonni aytadi (TA / CC / LR / GRA) va qanday tuzatishni aytadi.
items: Javobda umumiy tendensiya (overview) yo'q.
"The number of people was very big and it was nice."
"In 2015 young people watches TV 12 hours."
Hamma gap "Also, ..." bilan boshlanadi.
"I think young people are lazy now, so they use social media."
Javob faqat qisqa oddiy gaplardan iborat, bitta ham murakkab gap yo'q.
Oxirgi yildagi ma'lumot umuman tilga olinmagan.
Xatboshilar yo'q — butun javob bitta blok.
why: Overview — Task Achievement ning asosiy talabi.
"very big", "nice" — aniq emas; "a significant number", "the highest figure".
Zamon va moslashuv: "watched"; raqamdan keyin "hours a week".
Bog'lovchilar xilma-xil va o'rinli bo'lishi kerak: however, whereas, by contrast.
Fikr va sabab — Task 1 talabiga zid.
Band 7 uchun "a variety of complex structures" kerak.
"Covers all requirements" — hamma asosiy ma'lumotni qamrash.
Xatboshilar mantiqiy tartibni ko'rsatadi (kirish → overview → tafsilot).

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Task 1 da bu gap o'rinlimi?
class_ex.instr: Har gapga "ha" yoki "yo'q" deng va sababini ayting.
items: "Overall, the most striking change was the fall in television viewing."
"In my opinion, social media is dangerous for teenagers."
"This is probably because smartphones became cheaper."
"Reading was the least popular pastime in both years."
"To sum up, I believe people should read more books."
"Time spent on sport rose slightly, from 5 to 6 hours."
why: Overview — asosiy tendensiya, raqamsiz.
Fikr — Task 1 da so'ralmaydi.
Sabab grafikda yo'q — taxmin.
Solishtirish va asosiy xususiyat.
Fikrli xulosa — Task 2 uslubi.
Aniq tafsilot raqam bilan.

readings.title: Slaydlar 1–7: Task 1 nima? To'rt misol
readings.source: Ustoz bergan slaydlar (Section 1: General Overview)
readings.book_ref: 1–3: kurs va Task 1 ning asosiy talablari; 4–7: to'rt misol — pie charts, table, maps, process.

readings.title: Slaydlar 8–14: Examiner nimani baholaydi?
readings.source: Ustoz bergan slaydlar (Lecture 4: What do you want from me?)
readings.book_ref: 9: to'rt mezon; 10–13: har mezon — rasmiy talab va "in other words"; 14: band descriptorlar xulosasi.

readings.title: NAMUNA JAVOB — to'rt mezon qayerda ko'rinadi
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (163 so'z; ma'lumotlar mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The table below shows the average number of hours per week that young people in one city spent on four leisure activities in 2015 and 2025. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
text: The table compares the average number of hours per week that young people in one city spent on four leisure activities in 2015 and 2025.

Overall, the most striking change was a reversal in the popularity of television and social media: watching TV fell sharply, while social media became by far the most time-consuming activity. By contrast, the time given to sport and reading changed very little.

In 2015, young people spent 12 hours a week watching television, which was three times the figure for social media (4 hours). Over the following decade, however, television viewing dropped to just 5 hours, whereas time on social media more than tripled to 14 hours, overtaking every other activity.

Sport and reading remained minor activities in both years. Time spent on sport rose slightly, from 5 to 6 hours, while reading was the least popular pastime throughout, falling from 3 hours to only 2 hours a week, the lowest figure in the table for either year.
paraphrases: the figure for, time given to, time spent on
three times the figure for, whereas, by contrast

tasks.title: Ma'lumotlar jadvali (o'quvchiga savol bilan birga beriladi)
tasks.type: Average hours per week
tasks.instr: Avval jadvalni o'qing va eng katta ikki o'zgarishni o'zingiz toping; keyin namuna javobni o'qing.
head: Activity

tasks.title: Namunada to'rt mezonni toping
tasks.type: To'rt rang bilan belgilash
tasks.instr: Har savolga namunadan misol keltiring.
items: Qaysi xatboshi OVERVIEW? Unda raqam bormi?
Savoldagi "shows" kirishda nima bilan almashtirilgan?
Qarama-qarshilikni ko'rsatuvchi 4 ta bog'lovchini toping.
"the number of hours" o'rniga ishlatilgan 3 ta ifoda.
Bitta murakkab gap (which / whereas bilan) toping.
Nega sport va kitob o'qish bitta xatboshida?
answers: the figure for, time given to, time spent on
"..., which was three times the figure for social media" yoki "..., whereas time on social media more than tripled..."
Ikkalasi ham kam o'zgargan — o'xshash ma'lumotlar bitta guruhga
why: Task Achievement: overview — umumiy tendensiya, tafsilotsiz.
Lexical Resource: savolni ko'chirmaslik.
Coherence and Cohesion: bog'lovchilar xilma-xil.
Lexical Resource: takrordan qochish.
Grammatical Range: murakkab gaplar.
Coherence: mantiqiy guruhlash — keyingi darsning asosiy mavzusi.

homework_intro: Bugun Task 1 nima ekanini va examiner qaysi to'rt narsaga qarashini bildik. Uyda birinchi marta o'zingiz kirish va overview yozasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — quyidagi jadval uchun kirish (1 gap) va overview (2 gap) yozing: "The table shows the percentage of households in one town that owned four devices in 2005 and 2025: landline phone 90% → 30%; laptop 25% → 80%; smartphone 5% → 95%; DVD player 60% → 10%." 10 daqiqa.
Ikkinchi vazifa — yozganingizni to'rt mezon bo'yicha o'zingiz tekshiring: overview bormi (TA)? savol so'zlari ko'chirilmaganmi (LR)? bog'lovchi bormi (CC)? zamon to'g'rimi (GRA)?
Uchinchi vazifa — CORE va STRONG so'zlardan 8 tasi bilan namuna jadval haqida 8 gap.

homework.title: Kirish + overview (qurilmalar jadvali)
homework.instr: 1 gap kirish (paraphrase), 2 gap overview (raqamsiz). 10 daqiqa.
homework.answers: Namuna: "The table compares the proportion of households in a town that owned four types of device in 2005 and 2025. Overall, smartphones and laptops became almost universal, while landline phones and DVD players declined dramatically; the smartphone showed the greatest change of all."

homework.title: To'rt mezon bo'yicha o'z-o'zini tekshirish
homework.instr: Javobingiz ostiga TA / CC / LR / GRA — har biriga bitta "bor" yoki "yo'q" va sabab.
homework.answers: Ustoz keyingi darsda ikki o'quvchining tekshiruvini sinf bilan solishtiradi.

homework.title: 8 ta gap — Task 1 so'zlari bilan
homework.instr: CORE va STRONG ro'yxatidan 8 so'z, har biri bilan namuna jadval haqida bitta gap.
homework.answers: Har gapda raqam yoki solishtirish bo'lsin.

lessons.title: Writing Task 1 (2): 4 savol turi, 4 xatboshili formula va reja
lessons.grammar_topic: Task 1 ning 4 savol turi (vaqtli grafik, solishtirma grafik, jarayon, xarita), har savolga yaroqli 4 xatboshili formula va 1–2 daqiqalik reja
lessons.vocab_topic: Tendensiya tili: rise, fall, peak, remain stable, fluctuate + ravishlar (sharply, steadily, slightly)
lessons.book_ref: Ustoz bergan slaydlar: "Mastering IELTS Writing: Task 1 (Academic)", 15–20-slaydlar (Section 2: Approaching the response).
objectives: Task 1 savolini 4 turdan biriga ajratish: vaqt o'zgarishi bor grafik, vaqtsiz solishtirma grafik, jarayon, xarita.
Har savol turiga yaroqli 4 xatboshili formulani qo'llash: 1) kirish, 2) overview, 3) birinchi guruh tafsilotlar, 4) ikkinchi guruh tafsilotlar.
Overview va summary farqini bilish: ikkalasini ham yozmaslik, lekin bittasini albatta yozish — overview ikkinchi xatboshida.
Ma'lumotlarni 3- va 4-xatboshiga mantiqiy GURUHLASH: o'xshash tendensiya, kategoriya, bosqich yoki xarita qismi bo'yicha.
1–2 daqiqada qisqa belgilar bilan reja tuzish (↑ ↓ ++ →) va rejadan to'liq javob yozish.
materials: Slaydlar 15–20 (quyidagi Reading bo'limida) — proyektorda.
Jony Academy line graph'i (sport turlari, 2010–2020) — chop etilgan yoki ekranda.
Doskada formula: PARA 1 Introduction / PARA 2 Overview / PARA 3 Key details (1) / PARA 4 Key details (2).
Doskada belgilar lug'ati: ↑ oshdi, ↓ kamaydi, ++ yuqori va barqaror, → keyin, ≈ o'zgarmadi, pk cho'qqi.
Taymer: har reja uchun 2 daqiqa.
timeline: Takrorlash
19-dars: to'rt mezon va overview nima uchun kerak — 3 savol bilan.
4 savol turi (slaydlar 15–16)
Vaqtli grafik, solishtirma grafik, jarayon, xarita; har biriga qanday til kerak (1-mashq).
Formula (slayd 17)
4 xatboshi; overview yoki summary — ikkalasi emas, bittasi albatta; nega overview ikkinchi xatboshida.
Nega reja kerak (slaydlar 18–20)
Reja vaqt tejaydi; slayd 20 dagi belgilarni birga "ochish" (3-mashq).
Namuna: grafik → reja → javob
Jony Academy line graph'i; ustoz doskada reja tuzadi; namuna javob o'qiladi, xatboshilar formula bilan solishtiriladi.
Sinf mashqlari
2-mashq (guruhlash) va 4-mashq (xatboshilarni tartiblash).
Taymer: uchta reja
Slaydlar 4–7 dagi uchta misol uchun har biriga 2 daqiqada reja; juftlik solishtiradi.
Xulosa va vazifa
Uyga: berilgan ma'lumotdan to'liq javob, 20 daqiqa.

intro: Task 1 savollari 4 turga bo'linadi (slayd 16): 1) VAQTLI GRAFIK — yillar yoki oylar bo'yicha o'zgarish (line graph, ba'zan bar/table); 2) SOLISHTIRMA GRAFIK — vaqt yo'q, faqat kategoriyalar farqi (pie, bar, table); 3) JARAYON (process) — bosqichlar; 4) XARITA (map) — joy va o'zgarish.

Tur tilni belgilaydi: vaqtli grafikda o'zgarish tili (rose, fell, peaked, remained stable); solishtirmada solishtirish tili (higher than, twice as many, the largest proportion); jarayonda passiv va ketma-ketlik (is heated, after that, finally); xaritada joylashuv va o'zgarish (was built, was replaced, to the north of).

FORMULA (slayd 17) — Task 2 dan farqli, har qanday Task 1 savoliga bir xil: PARA 1 — kirish (savolni paraphrase qilish, 1 gap); PARA 2 — overview (eng muhim 2 ta umumiy xususiyat, raqamsiz); PARA 3 — birinchi guruh tafsilotlar; PARA 4 — ikkinchi guruh tafsilotlar.

Overview yoki summary: oxirida summary yozish ham mumkin, lekin ikkita qoida bor — IKKALASINI HECH QACHON yozmang, BITTASINI HAR DOIM yozing. Biz overview'ni ikkinchi xatboshida yozamiz: examiner eng muhim Task Achievement talabini birinchi qatorlardayoq ko'radi.
Overview uchun savol: "Agar grafikni 5 soniya ko'rsam, nimani eslab qolaman?" — eng katta/eng kichik, asosiy tendensiya (oshdi/kamaydi), eng katta o'zgarish, umumiy naqsh.

GURUHLASH — 3- va 4-xatboshining sifati: o'xshash tendensiyalar birga (oshganlar / kamayganlar), yoki yuqori va past kategoriyalar, yoki jarayonning birinchi va ikkinchi yarmi, yoki xaritaning shimoli va janubi. Har chiziqqa alohida xatboshi — xato.
REJA (slaydlar 18–20) 1–2 daqiqa: turini aniqlang → overview uchun 2 ta asosiy fikrni belgilar bilan yozing → P3 va P4 guruhlarini belgilang. Reja faqat siz uchun: "R↑ // F++ // B, S ↑→↓" yetarli.
Vaqt: 2 daqiqa reja + 15 daqiqa yozish + 3 daqiqa tekshirish = 20 daqiqa.
formulas: "The line graph illustrates how many students ... took part in four sports between 2010 and 2020."
"Overall, football was the most popular sport throughout..., whereas basketball and swimming rose at first but then declined."
presentation: Summary va overview farqi nima?
Overview — ikkinchi xatboshida umumiy tendensiya; summary — oxirida xuddi shunday xulosa. Bittasi yetarli, ikkalasi takror.
Kirish necha gap?
Bitta gap yetarli: savolni paraphrase qiling (shows → illustrates / compares; between 2010 and 2020 → over a ten-year period).
Guruhni qanday tanlayman?
O'xshash tendensiyali ma'lumotlarni birga qo'ying. Rejada doira bilan belgilang.
Reja yozishga vaqt yo'q-ku?
Reja vaqtni tejaydi: 2 daqiqa rejasiz yozilgan javob ko'pincha 5 daqiqa qayta yozishga olib keladi.
Jarayon va xaritada ham shu formula?
Ha. Jarayonda P3 — birinchi yarim bosqichlar, P4 — ikkinchi yarim; xaritada P3 — nima o'zgardi, P4 — nima qo'shildi yoki boshqa qism.
Hamma raqamni yozamanmi?
Yo'q. Boshlanish, oxir, cho'qqi va eng katta farqlar yetarli.
notes: Slayd 20 dagi rejani o'quvchilar "Umm... what?!" deb qabul qiladi — maqsad shu: reja faqat yozuvchi uchun. 3-mashqda belgilarni birga gapga aylantiring.
Keyingi Writing darslarida har javob shu formula bo'yicha tekshiriladi: 4 xatboshi, overview ikkinchi o'rinda, guruhlash mantiqiy.
Namuna grafikdagi ma'lumotlar mashq uchun to'qilgan.

how: CORE — o'zgarish fe'llari; STRONG — ravishlar va otlar; SUPER — Band 7 iboralari.
Namuna grafikdagi har chiziq uchun CORE fe'l + STRONG ravish bilan bitta gap tuzing.
core: Running rose steadily throughout the decade.
Yugurish o'n yil davomida bir tekis oshdi.
Ikkala sport ham 2016 dan keyin pasaydi.
Football was the most popular throughout the period.
Futbol butun davr bo'yi eng mashhur edi.
strong: Yugurish har yili bir tekis o'sdi.
super: Basketball and swimming followed a similar pattern.
Basketbol va suzish o'xshash naqshda o'zgardi.
Swimming fell, ending the decade at 120.
Suzish kamayib, o'n yillikni 120 bilan yakunladi.
Running, by contrast, grew every year.
Yugurish esa, aksincha, har yili o'sdi.

class_ex.title: 1-mashq: To'rt turdan qaysi biri? Qanday til kerak?
class_ex.instr: Har savolga: tur (vaqtli grafik / solishtirma grafik / jarayon / xarita) va asosiy til (o'zgarish / solishtirish / passiv + ketma-ketlik / joylashuv).
items: The graph shows car ownership in three countries from 1990 to 2020.
The pie chart shows how a university spent its budget in 2024.
The diagram shows how chocolate is produced.
The maps show a town centre in 1995 and today.
The bar chart shows the number of international students in five countries in 2022.
The table shows the monthly sales of three smartphone brands from January to June.
answers: solishtirma grafik — solishtirish tili (the largest proportion)
xarita — joylashuv va o'zgarish (was replaced, was built)
why: "from 1990 to 2020" — vaqt.
Bitta yil — vaqt o'zgarishi yo'q.
"how ... is produced" — bosqichlar.
Ikki davr xaritasi — nima o'zgargan.
Bitta yil, besh davlat — kategoriyalar farqi.
Oylar bo'yicha — jadval ham vaqtli bo'lishi mumkin. Turni jadval yoki grafik emas, VAQT belgilaydi.

class_ex.title: 2-mashq: Guruhlash — P3 va P4 ga nima tushadi?
class_ex.instr: Har ma'lumotlar to'plami uchun P3 va P4 guruhini taklif qiling va sababini ayting.
items: Line graph, 4 chiziq: A va C oshgan, B va D kamaygan.
Pie chart: 6 ta xarajat turi — uchtasi katta (30%, 25%, 20%), uchtasi kichik (10%, 8%, 7%).
Process: 8 bosqich — 1–4 zavodda, 5–8 do'konda.
Map: shimoliy qismda park va maktab qurilgan, janubiy qismda fermalar uy-joyga aylangan.
Table: 6 shahar metrosi — ikkitasi eng eski va eng uzun, ikkitasi eng yangi va eng qisqa.
answers: P3: A + C (oshganlar); P4: B + D (kamayganlar)
P3: uchta katta ulush; P4: uchta kichik ulush
P3: shimoliy qism; P4: janubiy qism
P3: eski va katta tizimlar; P4: yangi va kichik tizimlar
why: O'xshash tendensiya — bitta xatboshida.
Kattalik bo'yicha guruh — solishtirish oson.
Jarayonning tabiiy ikki yarmi.
Xaritada joy bo'yicha guruhlash eng tabiiy.
Slayd 5 dagi jadval kabi: xususiyatlar bo'yicha ikki guruh.

class_ex.title: 3-mashq: Rejani "ochish" (slayd 20)
class_ex.instr: Slayd 20 dagi reja belgilarini to'liq gapga aylantiring. R = Running, F = Football, B = Basketball, S = Swimming.
items: R ↑
P3: R + S
P4: F + B
answers: Football was high throughout / remained the most popular.
Basketball stayed high at first, then declined.
Swimming rose at first, then fell.
why: ↑ — oshish.
++ — yuqori va barqaror.
+ → ↓ — avval yuqori, keyin kamayish.
↑ → ↓ — avval o'sish, keyin kamayish.
Reja guruhlarni ham ko'rsatadi.
Ikkinchi guruh — alohida xatboshi.
class_ex.note: Belgilar har o'quvchida har xil bo'lishi mumkin — asosiysi, 2 daqiqada tushunarli bo'lsin.

class_ex.title: 4-mashq: Xatboshilarni formula bo'yicha tartiblang
class_ex.instr: Ustoz namuna javobning 4 xatboshisini aralash tartibda o'qiydi (yoki qirqilgan tasmalar beradi). To'g'ri tartibni tiklang va har birining nomini ayting.
items: "Basketball and swimming followed a very similar pattern..."
"The line graph illustrates how many students..."
"Football attracted around 420 students in 2010..."
"Overall, football was the most popular sport..."
why: Ikkinchi guruh: bir xil naqshdagi ikki sport.
Savolning paraphrase'i.
Birinchi guruh: yuqori va o'sib borgan sportlar, raqamlar bilan.
Umumiy tendensiya, raqamsiz.

readings.title: Slaydlar 15–20: Savol turlari, formula va reja
readings.source: Ustoz bergan slaydlar (Section 2: Approaching the response — Lecture 5, 7)
readings.book_ref: 16: to'rt savol turi; 17: har savolga formula (4 xatboshi, overview yoki summary); 18–20: nega reja kerak va reja namunasi.

readings.title: NAMUNA: grafik → reja → javob
readings.source: Jony Academy namuna javobi (160 so'z; grafik ma'lumotlari mashq uchun to'qilgan)
readings.book_ref: SAVOL: The graph below shows the number of students taking part in four sports at a university between 2010 and 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.  |  REJA (2 daqiqa): O: F ++ (tepada, ≈) // R ↑↑ (90 → 400) // B, S ↑ → ↓ (pk 2016). P3: F + R. P4: B + S.
text: The line graph illustrates how many students at one university took part in four sports — football, running, basketball and swimming — between 2010 and 2020.

Overall, football was the most popular sport throughout the period and its numbers remained almost unchanged. Running showed the most dramatic growth, becoming nearly as popular as football by 2020, whereas basketball and swimming both rose at first but then declined sharply.

Football attracted around 420 students in 2010, and this figure stayed remarkably stable, finishing the decade at 445. Running, by contrast, began as the least popular activity, with only 90 participants, but it grew steadily every year, reaching 400 by 2020.

Basketball and swimming followed a very similar pattern. Participation in basketball climbed from 200 to a peak of 330 in 2016, and swimming rose from 150 to 260 over the same period. After 2016, however, both fell dramatically, ending the decade at 150 and 120 respectively, lower than their starting points.
glossary: throughout the period — butun davr bo'yi
paraphrases: the number of students taking part in
how many students ... took part in

tasks.title: Namunani formula bilan tekshiring
tasks.type: Og'zaki
tasks.instr: Grafik va rejaga qarab javob bering.
items: Overview'dagi ikki asosiy fikr qaysi?
Nega football va running bitta xatboshida?
Nega basketball va swimming bitta xatboshida?
"respectively" nimani bildiradi?
Rejadagi "pk 2016" javobning qaysi gapida?
Javobda summary (oxirgi xulosa) bormi? Nega?
answers: Football eng mashhur va barqaror; running eng tez o'sgan, basketball va swimming avval o'sib keyin kamaygan
Ikkalasi 2020 da eng yuqori ikkita; biri barqaror, biri o'sgan — qarama-qarshilik bilan (by contrast)
Bir xil naqsh: 2016 gacha o'sish, keyin keskin tushish
"climbed from 200 to a peak of 330 in 2016"
Yo'q — overview bor, ikkalasi kerak emas
why: Overview — raqamsiz, 2 ta umumiy xususiyat.
Guruhlash: 2020 dagi eng yuqori ikki sport; "by contrast" farqni ko'rsatadi.
"followed a very similar pattern" — guruh sababi aniq aytilgan.
Ikki raqamni bitta gapda berish usuli.
Reja belgisi → aniq gap.
Slayd 17: NEVER write both, ALWAYS write one.

homework_intro: Bugun har qanday Task 1 savoliga yaroqli formulani o'rgandik: kirish, overview, ikki guruh tafsilot — va 2 daqiqalik reja. Uyda birinchi to'liq javobingizni yozasiz.

Birinchi vazifa — to'liq javob, 20 daqiqa (2 reja + 15 yozish + 3 tekshirish): "The graph shows the average price of a cinema ticket and a monthly streaming subscription in one country, 2014–2024: cinema £8 → £9 → £11 → £12 (2014, 2017, 2020, 2024); streaming £6 → £8 → £9 → £13." Avval rejani yozing, keyin 4 xatboshi.
Ikkinchi vazifa — slaydlar 4–7 dagi to'rt misoldan ikkitasiga faqat REJA (2 daqiqadan): overview uchun 2 fikr va P3/P4 guruhlari.
Uchinchi vazifa — CORE fe'llar + STRONG ravishlar bilan sport grafigi haqida 6 gap (har sport uchun kamida bitta).

homework.title: To'liq javob: kino va streaming narxi
homework.instr: Reja + 4 xatboshi, 160–190 so'z, 20 daqiqa. Overview ikkinchi xatboshida, raqamsiz.
